name: apple
description: Choose Apple connectors and ask Codex about the data they import on your Mac.

interface.longDescription: Connect Mail, Notes, Messages, Contacts, Calendar, Reminders, Safari, Books, your call history, your notifications, your Mac's accounts and its activity, and add other Mac apps by asking Codex to write a connector for them. Choose connectors and accounts, folders, mailboxes, chats, calendars, lists or Safari profiles during setup. Apple imports the selected content into a private local copy while you use it and reports when it last synced. macOS controls access to your apps. Requires the ChatGPT desktop app on a Mac.
defaultPrompt: What did I read and highlight this week?
